blocks.text: Sculpture by the Sea 2026: Bondi comes alive with beachside art – in pictures

Australia’s largest free outdoor sculpture exhibition returns to Sydney’s 2km Bondi to Tamarama coastal walk, showcasing work by artists from around the world. The annual exhibition is on now until 2 November

blocks.alt: Visitors stand beneath Nenad Milovanovic’s Support IV sculpture overlooking the ocean at Bondi
